metadata.platformNote: Xbox, Windows, Android, iOS, and Nintendo Switch use Microsoft-account achievements. PlayStation records supported goals as PSN trophies.

achievements.title: Taking Inventory
achievements.description: Open your inventory.
achievements.guide: Open your inventory.

achievements.title: Getting Wood
achievements.description: Punch a tree until a block of wood pops out.
achievements.guide: Pick up a log from the ground.

achievements.title: Benchmaking
achievements.description: Craft a workbench with four blocks of wooden planks.
achievements.guide: Pick up a crafting table from the inventory's crafting field output or a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Time to Mine!
achievements.description: Use planks and sticks to make a pickaxe.
achievements.guide: Pick up any type of pickaxe from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Hot Topic
achievements.description: Construct a furnace out of eight cobblestone blocks.
achievements.guide: Pick up a furnace from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Acquire Hardware
achievements.description: Smelt an iron ingot
achievements.guide: Pick up an iron ingot from a furnace output.

achievements.title: Time to Farm!
achievements.description: Make a Hoe.
achievements.guide: Pick up any type of hoe from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Bake Bread
achievements.description: Turn wheat into bread.
achievements.guide: Pick up bread from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: The Lie
achievements.description: Bake a cake using: wheat, sugar, milk, and eggs.
achievements.guide: Pick up a cake from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Getting an Upgrade
achievements.description: Construct a better pickaxe.
achievements.guide: Pick up a stone pickaxe from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Delicious Fish
achievements.description: Catch and cook a fish!
achievements.guide: Pick up a cooked cod after cooking it in a Furnace, Smoker, Campfire, or Soul Campfire. Doesn't work if the block used is hooked up to a hopper, as the player is not getting the item directly from the output.

achievements.title: On A Rail
achievements.description: Travel by minecart to a point at least 500m in a single direction from where you started.
achievements.guide: Travel by minecart 500 blocks in a straight line away from the player's starting point.

achievements.title: Time to Strike!
achievements.description: Use planks and sticks to make a sword.
achievements.guide: Pick up any type of sword from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Monster Hunter
achievements.description: Attack and destroy a monster.
achievements.guide: Kill a hostile mob or one of the following neutral mobs: an enderman, a piglin, a zombified piglin, a spider, or a cave spider.

achievements.title: Cow Tipper
achievements.description: Harvest some leather.
achievements.guide: Pick up leather from the ground.

achievements.title: When Pigs Fly
achievements.description: Use a saddle to ride a pig, and then have the pig get hurt from fall damage while riding it.
achievements.guide: Be riding a pig (e.g. using a saddle) when it hits the ground with a fall distance greater than 5.

achievements.title: Sniper Duel
achievements.description: Kill a Skeleton with an arrow from more than 50 meters.
achievements.guide: Use a launched arrow to kill a skeleton, spider jockey, wither skeleton, or a stray from 50 or more blocks away, horizontally.

achievements.title: DIAMONDS!
achievements.description: Acquire diamonds with your iron tools.
achievements.guide: Pick up a diamond from the ground.

achievements.title: Into The Nether
achievements.description: Construct a Nether Portal.
achievements.guide: Light a nether portal.

achievements.title: Return to Sender
achievements.description: Destroy a Ghast with a fireball.
achievements.guide: Kill a ghast using a ghast fireball.

achievements.title: Into Fire
achievements.description: Relieve a Blaze of its rod.
achievements.guide: Pick up a blaze rod from the ground.

achievements.title: Local Brewery
achievements.description: Brew a potion.
achievements.guide: Pick up a potion from a brewing stand potion slot. An already-created potion placed and removed qualifies.

achievements.title: The End?
achievements.description: Enter an End Portal
achievements.guide: Enter a stronghold End Portal activated with all twelve eyes of ender.

achievements.title: The End
achievements.description: Kill the Enderdragon
achievements.guide: Enter the end exit portal.

achievements.title: Enchanter
achievements.description: Construct an Enchantment Table.
achievements.guide: Pick up an enchantment table from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Overkill
achievements.description: Deal nine hearts of damage in a single hit.
achievements.guide: Damage can be dealt to any mob, even those that do not have nine hearts of health overall.

achievements.title: Librarian
achievements.description: Build some bookshelves to improve your enchantment table.
achievements.guide: Pick up a bookshelf from a crafting table output.

achievements.title: Adventuring Time
achievements.description: Discover 17 biomes.
achievements.guide: Visit any 17 biomes. Does not have to be in a single world.

achievements.title: The Beginning?
achievements.description: Spawn the Wither
achievements.guide: Be within a 100.9×100.9×103.5 cuboid centered on the Wither when it is spawned.

achievements.title: The Beginning.
achievements.description: Kill the Wither
achievements.guide: Be within a 100.9×100.9×203.5 cuboid centered on the Wither when it drops the nether star.

achievements.title: The Beaconator
achievements.description: Create and fully power a Beacon
achievements.guide: Be within a 20×20×14 cuboid centered on the pyramid when the beacon block realizes it is fully powered.

achievements.title: Repopulation
achievements.description: Breed two cows with wheat.
achievements.guide: Breed two cows or two mooshrooms.

achievements.title: Diamonds to you!
achievements.description: Throw diamonds at another player.
achievements.guide: Drop a diamond. Another player or a mob must then pick up this diamond.

achievements.title: Overpowered
achievements.description: Eat an Enchanted Apple
achievements.guide: Eat an Enchanted Apple

achievements.title: MOAR Tools
achievements.description: Construct one type of each tool.
achievements.guide: Construct one pickaxe, one shovel, one axe, and one hoe with the same material.

achievements.title: Dispense with This
achievements.description: Construct a Dispenser.
achievements.guide: Construct a Dispenser.

achievements.title: Leader of the Pack
achievements.description: Befriend five wolves.
achievements.guide: This does not have to be in a single game, so multiple games or reloading old saves does count toward this achievement.

achievements.title: Pork Chop
achievements.description: Cook and eat a pork chop.
achievements.guide: Cook and eat a pork chop.

achievements.title: Passing the Time
achievements.description: Play for 100 days.
achievements.guide: Play for 100 Minecraft days, which is equivalent to 33 hours in real time.

achievements.title: The Haggler
achievements.description: Acquire or spend 30 Emeralds by trading with villagers or with wandering trader.
achievements.guide: Acquire or spend 30 Emeralds by trading with villagers or with wandering trader.

achievements.title: Pot Planter
achievements.description: Craft and place a Flower Pot.
achievements.guide: Craft and place a Flower Pot.

achievements.title: It's a Sign!
achievements.description: Craft and place an Oak Sign.
achievements.guide: Craft and place an Oak Sign.

achievements.title: Iron Belly
achievements.description: Stop starvation using Rotten Flesh.
achievements.guide: Eat a piece of rotten flesh while starving (zero hunger points).

achievements.title: Have a Shearful Day
achievements.description: Use Shears to obtain wool from a sheep.
achievements.guide: Use Shears to obtain wool from a sheep.

achievements.title: Rainbow Collection
achievements.description: Gather all 16 colors of wool.
achievements.guide: All the colors of wool do not have to be in the inventory at the same time, but must have been picked up by the player at least once.

achievements.title: Stayin' Frosty
achievements.description: Swim in lava while having the Fire Resistance effect.
achievements.guide: Swim in lava while having the Fire Resistance effect.

achievements.title: Chestful of Cobblestone
achievements.description: Mine 1,728 Cobblestone and place it in a chest.
achievements.guide: A player must mine 1,728 cobblestone and place 1,728 cobblestone, or 27 stacks, in a chest. The cobblestone placed in the chest does not have to be the same cobblestone that was mined.

achievements.title: Renewable Energy
achievements.description: Smelt wood trunks using charcoal to make more charcoal.
achievements.guide: Smelt a wooden log with charcoal as the fuel.

achievements.title: Body Guard
achievements.description: Create an Iron Golem
achievements.guide: Create an Iron Golem

achievements.title: Iron Man
achievements.description: Wear a full suit of Iron Armor.
achievements.guide: Wear a full suit of Iron Armor.

achievements.title: Zombie Doctor
achievements.description: Cure a zombie villager.
achievements.guide: Throw a splash potion of weakness at a zombie villager and give it a golden apple (by facing the zombie and pressing the use key with a golden apple in your hand)

achievements.title: Lion Hunter
achievements.description: Gain the trust of an Ocelot.
achievements.guide: Gain the trust of an Ocelot.

achievements.title: Archer
achievements.description: Kill a creeper with arrows.
achievements.guide: Kill a creeper with arrows.

achievements.title: Tie Dye Outfit
achievements.description: Use a cauldron to dye all 4 unique pieces of leather armor.
achievements.guide: Use a cauldron to dye all 4 unique pieces of leather armor.

achievements.title: Trampoline
achievements.description: Bounce 30 blocks upward off a slime block.
achievements.guide: Bounce 30 blocks upward off a slime block.

achievements.title: Camouflage
achievements.description: Kill a mob while wearing the same type of mob head.
achievements.guide: Kill a mob while wearing the same type of mob head.

achievements.title: Map Room
achievements.description: Place 9 fully explored, adjacent map items into 9 item frames in a 3 by 3 square.
achievements.guide: The frames have to be on a wall, not the floor.

achievements.title: Freight Station
achievements.description: Use a Hopper to move an item from a Chest Minecart to a Chest.
achievements.guide: Use a Hopper to move an item from a Chest Minecart to a Chest.

achievements.title: Smelt Everything!
achievements.description: Connect 3 Chests to a single Furnace using 3 Hoppers.
achievements.guide: Be within the range of three chests connected to a Furnace with 3 Hoppers.

achievements.title: Taste of Your Own Medicine
achievements.description: Poison a witch with a splash potion.
achievements.guide: Throw a splash potion of poison at a witch (by facing the witch and pressing the use key).

achievements.title: Inception
achievements.description: Push a piston with a piston, then pull the original piston with that piston.
achievements.guide: Push a piston with a piston, then pull the original piston with that piston.

achievements.title: Saddle Up
achievements.description: Tame a horse.
achievements.guide: Tame a horse.

achievements.title: Artificial Selection
achievements.description: Breed a mule from a horse and a donkey.
achievements.guide: Breed a mule from a horse and a donkey.

achievements.title: Free Diver
achievements.description: Stay underwater for 2 minutes
achievements.guide: Drink a potion of water breathing that can last for 2 minutes or more, then jump into the water or activate a conduit or sneak on a magma block underwater for 2 minutes.

achievements.title: Rabbit Season
achievements.description: Cook and Eat Rabbit Meat
achievements.guide: Cook and Eat Rabbit Meat

achievements.title: The Deep End
achievements.description: Defeat an Elder Guardian
achievements.guide: Defeat an Elder Guardian

achievements.title: Dry Spell
achievements.description: Dry a sponge in a furnace
achievements.guide: Dry a sponge in a furnace

achievements.title: Super Fuel
achievements.description: Power a Furnace with Lava
achievements.guide: Power a Furnace with Lava

achievements.title: You Need a Mint
achievements.description: Collect dragons breath in a glass bottle
achievements.guide: Have a dragon's breath bottle in your inventory

achievements.title: Beam Me Up
achievements.description: Teleport over 100 meters from a single throw of an Ender Pearl
achievements.guide: Throw an ender pearl 100 blocks in any direction

achievements.title: The End... Again...
achievements.description: Respawn the Enderdragon
achievements.guide: Respawn the Enderdragon

achievements.title: Great View From Up Here
achievements.description: Levitate up 50 blocks from the attacks of a Shulker
achievements.guide: Levitate up 50 blocks from the attacks of a Shulker

achievements.title: Super Sonic
achievements.description: Use Elytra to fly through a 1 by 1 gap while moving faster than 40 m/s
achievements.guide: Use Elytra to fly through a 1 by 1 gap while moving faster than 40 m/s

achievements.title: Treasure Hunter
achievements.description: Acquire a map from a cartographer villager, then enter the revealed structure
achievements.guide: Visit the structure indicated while the purchased map is in your main hand (hotbar).

achievements.title: Organizational Wizard
achievements.description: Name a Shulker Box with an Anvil
achievements.guide: Name a Shulker Box with an Anvil

achievements.title: Cheating Death
achievements.description: Use the Totem of Undying to cheat death
achievements.guide: Have the Totem of Undying in your hand when you die.

achievements.title: Feeling Ill
achievements.description: Defeat an Evoker
achievements.guide: Defeat an Evoker

achievements.title: Let It Go!
achievements.description: Using the Frost Walker boots, walk on at least 1 block on frozen water on a deep ocean
achievements.guide: Using the Frost Walker boots, walk on at least 1 block on frozen water on a deep ocean

achievements.title: So I Got That Going for Me
achievements.description: Lead a Caravan containing at least 5 Llamas
achievements.guide: Lead a Caravan containing at least 5 Llamas

achievements.title: Atlantis?
achievements.description: Find an underwater ruin
achievements.guide: Find an underwater ruin

achievements.title: Sail the 7 Seas
achievements.description: Visit all ocean biomes
achievements.guide: Visit all ocean biomes except the deep warm ocean/legacy frozen ocean (as they are unused)

achievements.title: Castaway
achievements.description: Eat nothing but dried kelp for three in-game days
achievements.guide: Eat dried kelp once; in the following three in-game days, eat nothing but dried kelp.

achievements.title: Ahoy!
achievements.description: Find a shipwreck
achievements.guide: Find a shipwreck

achievements.title: I am a Marine Biologist
achievements.description: Collect a fish in a bucket
achievements.guide: Use an empty bucket on any fish mob to collect it.

achievements.title: Me Gold!
achievements.description: Dig up a buried treasure
achievements.guide: Open a buried treasure chest

achievements.title: Sleep with the Fishes
achievements.description: Spend a day underwater.
achievements.guide: Spend 20 minutes underwater without any air.

achievements.title: Alternative Fuel
achievements.description: Power a furnace with a kelp block
achievements.guide: This achievement is awarded only if the dried kelp block is put into the furnace's fuel slot manually, not via redstone components such as hoppers.

achievements.title: Do a Barrel Roll!
achievements.description: Use Riptide to give yourself a boost
achievements.guide: Obtain a trident enchanted with Riptide and launch yourself any distance with it.

achievements.title: One Pickle, Two Pickle, Sea Pickle, Four
achievements.description: Place four Sea Pickles in a group
achievements.guide: Place four Sea Pickles in a group

achievements.title: Echolocation
achievements.description: Feed a dolphin fish to have it lead you to treasure
achievements.guide: Feed a dolphin cod or salmon and have it lure you to treasure.

achievements.title: Moskstraumen
achievements.description: Activate a Conduit
achievements.guide: Place a conduit in a valid prismarine/sea lantern structure to activate it.

achievements.title: Top of the World
achievements.description: Place scaffolding to the world limit.
achievements.guide: Place a scaffolding at the world height limit.

achievements.title: Where Have You Been?
achievements.description: Receive a gift from a tamed cat in the morning.
achievements.guide: The gift must be picked up from the ground.

achievements.title: Zoologist
achievements.description: Breed two pandas with bamboo.
achievements.guide: Breed two pandas with bamboo.

achievements.title: Fruit on the Loom
achievements.description: Make a banner using an Enchanted Apple Stencil
achievements.guide: Make a banner using the Enchanted apple (thing) stencil

achievements.title: Plethora of Cats
achievements.description: Befriend twenty stray cats.
achievements.guide: Befriend and tame twenty stray cats found in villages. They do not all need to be tamed in a single world.

achievements.title: Kill the Beast!
achievements.description: Defeat a Ravager.
achievements.guide: Defeat a Ravager.

achievements.title: Buy Low, Sell High
achievements.description: Trade for the best possible price.
achievements.guide: Buy something for 1 emerald, or when the Hero of the Village effect is applied.

achievements.title: Disenchanted
achievements.description: Use a Grindstone to get experience from an enchanted item.
achievements.guide: Use a Grindstone to get experience from an enchanted item.

achievements.title: We're being attacked!
achievements.description: Trigger a Pillager Raid.
achievements.guide: Walk in a village with the Bad Omen effect applied.

achievements.title: Sound the Alarm!
achievements.description: Ring the bell with a hostile enemy in the village.
achievements.guide: Ring the bell with a hostile enemy in the village.

achievements.title: I've got a bad feeling about this
achievements.description: Kill a Pillager Captain.
achievements.guide: Gain the bad omen effect, via drinking an ominous bottle, or killing a pillager captain in versions before the Tricky Trials update.

achievements.title: Master Trader
achievements.description: Trade for 1,000 emeralds.
achievements.guide: Obtain 1,000 emeralds from trading with villagers.

achievements.title: Time for Stew
achievements.description: Give someone a suspicious stew.
achievements.guide: Give someone a suspicious stew.

achievements.title: Bee our guest
achievements.description: Use a Campfire to collect Honey from a Beehive using a Bottle without aggravating the bees.
achievements.guide: Use a Campfire to collect Honey from a Beehive using a Bottle without aggravating the bees.

achievements.title: Total Beelocation
achievements.description: Move and place a Bee Nest, with 3 bees inside, using Silk Touch.
achievements.guide: Move and place a Bee Nest, with 3 bees inside, using Silk Touch.

achievements.title: Sticky Situation
achievements.description: Slide down a honey block to slow your fall.
achievements.guide: Slide down a honey block to slow your fall.

achievements.title: Bullseye
achievements.description: Hit the bullseye of a Target block
achievements.guide: Hit the bullseye of a Target block

achievements.title: Cover me in debris
achievements.description: Wear a full set of Netherite armor
achievements.guide: Have a full set of Netherite armor in your inventory.

achievements.title: Oooh, shiny!
achievements.description: Distract a Piglin using gold
achievements.guide: Give a piglin a gold item while it is aggressive toward the player.

achievements.title: Hot tourist destination
achievements.description: Visit all Nether biomes
achievements.guide: The achievement can be completed if one visit biomes in different worlds.

achievements.title: Whatever Floats Your Goat
achievements.description: Get in a boat and float with a goat
achievements.guide: Use a boat and put a goat inside that boat, then ride it

achievements.title: Wax on, Wax off
achievements.description: Apply and remove Wax from all the Copper blocks!!!
achievements.guide: Wax and de-wax each oxidation stage of all 4 Copper Blocks in the game, which include cut copper blocks, stairs, & slabs.

achievements.title: The Healing Power of Friendship!
achievements.description: Team up with an axolotl and win a fight
achievements.guide: Team up with an axolotl by killing the hostile aquatic mob while the axolotl is fighting it (not playing dead).

achievements.title: Caves & Cliffs
achievements.description: Freefall from the top of the world (build limit) to the bottom of the world and survive.
achievements.guide: Freefall from the top of the world (build limit) to the bottom of the world and survive.

achievements.title: Star trader
achievements.description: Trade with a villager at the build height limit.
achievements.guide: Trade with a villager at y320.

achievements.title: Sound of Music
achievements.description: Make the Meadows come alive with the sound of music from a jukebox.
achievements.guide: Use a music disc on a jukebox in the Meadow biome.

achievements.title: Feels Like Home
achievements.description: Take a Strider for a loooong ride on a lava lake in the Overworld.
achievements.guide: In the Overworld, use a strider to ride on a lava lake for a distance of 50 meters from the point where the ride starts.

achievements.title: It spreads
achievements.description: Kill a mob next to a catalyst
achievements.guide: Kill a mob next to a catalyst

achievements.title: Birthday song
achievements.description: Have an Allay drop a cake at a noteblock
achievements.guide: Tame an allay by giving it a cake while having dropped cake items and play a noteblock nearby.

achievements.title: With our powers combined!
achievements.description: Have all 3 froglights in your inventory
achievements.guide: Acquire at least one of each pearlescent, verdant, and ochre froglights in your inventory at the same time.

achievements.title: Sneak 100
achievements.description: Sneaking next to a Sculk Sensor without triggering it
achievements.guide: Sneak next to a Sculk Sensor or Warden without triggering or aggravating it.

achievements.title: Planting the past
achievements.description: Plant any Sniffer seed
achievements.guide: Plant any Sniffer seed

achievements.title: Careful restoration
achievements.description: Make a Decorated Pot out of 4 Pottery Sherds
achievements.guide: Make a Decorated Pot out of 4 Pottery Sherds

achievements.title: Smithing with style
achievements.description: Apply these smithing templates at least once: Spire, Snout, Rib, Ward, Silence, Vex, Tide, Wayfinder
achievements.guide: Apply these smithing templates at least once: Spire, Snout, Rib, Ward, Silence, Vex, Tide, Wayfinder

achievements.title: Crafters Crafting Crafters
achievements.description: Be near a Crafter when it crafts a Crafter
achievements.guide: Be near a Crafter when it crafts a Crafter

achievements.title: Who Needs Rockets?
achievements.description: Use a Wind Charge to launch yourself upward 8 blocks
achievements.guide: Use a Wind Charge to launch yourself upward 8 blocks

achievements.title: Over-Overkill
achievements.description: Deal 50 hearts of damage in a single hit using the Mace
achievements.guide: Deal 50 hearts of damage in a single hit using the Mace

achievements.title: Revaulting
achievements.description: Unlock an Ominous Vault with an Ominous Trial Key
achievements.guide: Unlock an Ominous Vault with an Ominous Trial Key

achievements.title: Stay Hydrated!
achievements.description: Place a Dried Ghast block into water
achievements.guide: Place a Dried Ghast block into water

achievements.title: Mob Kabob
achievements.description: Hit five mobs with the same Charge with the Spear
achievements.guide: Hit five mobs with the same Charge with the Spear
